rules.node: an element of a v2 nodes.json `nodes` array (legacy: a node of a component graph.roots tree, children included) — what the runtime instantiates
rules.handObjects: the scoping count: any JSON object with `type` and `id`; it also counts each component record in component.json (componentRecords = handObjects − nodes)
rules.known: type has a non-contract spec in the nodegx-node-spec registry, or is graded by an N graph scenario claim — conforming on the runtime by phase 107's ledger
rules.script: a T6 node of phase-107 tiers.json (Function, Script, Expression, Visual Function), or a kit type (not in the shipped catalog, not a component) with no spec
rules.unspecced: a shipped type with no spec and no graph claim yet — neither known nor script
rules.instance: a component instance (type starts with / or #) — counted inside its component, not again here
rules.exempt: a type exemptions.json says owes no spec (Component Children, CSS Definition)
rules.percent: known ÷ (known + script) × 100, by node instance, one decimal
rules.percentByLines: known ÷ (known + Σ max(1, script lines)) × 100 — each script node weighed by its lines, a kit node by 1
